единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is the model marketed as Nano Banana 2.
The model ID for Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) is gemini-3.1-flash-image.
Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is optimized for image understanding and generation and offers a balance of price and performance.

image understanding and generation and offers a balance of price and
performance.

единицы.утверждение_en: A 512 output image is approximately 0.25 megapixels and consumes 747 output image tokens.
единицы.заметка: В txt колонки склеены; по html: 512 | 0.25 | 747.

единицы.утверждение_en: A 1K output image is approximately 1 megapixel and consumes 1,120 output image tokens.
A 2K output image is approximately 4 megapixels and consumes 1,680 output image tokens.
A 4K output image is approximately 16 megapixels and consumes 2,520 output image tokens.
Additional charges apply for input and output tokens of other modalities such as text and video; the pricing page has the latest prices.
единицы.цитата:
Note: Additional charges apply for input and output tokens for other modalities,
such as text and video.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: On this card output image tokens rise at every resolution step (747 at 512, 1,120 at 1K, 1,680 at 2K, 2,520 at 4K), so 512 is the cheapest output size, while each input image costs a flat 1,120 tokens.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сопоставление строк таблицы; шаг ≈×1.5 между соседними разрешениями — арифметика, не слова Google.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Because output-image count is capped only by the 32,768 output-token limit, arithmetic from the table gives about 13 images at 4K, 19 at 2K, 29 at 1K or 43 at 512 per response before any text or thought tokens.
Video can be supplied as input (not output) and used for image generation from video: up to 10 video files or 1 YouTube URL per prompt, up to about 25 minutes within the 128k context.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сведение трёх разделов карточки; страница не говорит, сколько кадров/токенов уходит на секунду видео.
